description: This file defines custom error types for the Mattermost server, including errors for invalid input, limits exceeded, conflicts, not found, out of bounds, not implemented, and unique constraints.

classes.name: ErrInvalidInput
classes.description: Represents an error due to invalid input, with methods for error message formatting, wrapping, unwrapping, and retrieving info.

classes.name: ErrLimitExceeded
classes.description: Represents an error when a limit is exceeded.

classes.name: ErrConflict
classes.description: Represents a conflict error, with methods for error message formatting, unwrapping, and type assertion.

classes.name: ErrNotFound
classes.description: Represents a not found error, with methods for error message formatting, wrapping, and type assertion.

classes.name: ErrOutOfBounds
classes.description: Represents an error when a requested limit exceeds allowed bounds.

classes.name: ErrUniqueConstraint
classes.description: Represents a uniqueness constraint violation error.

methods.name: NewErrInvalidInput
methods.description: Creates a new ErrInvalidInput instance.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for invalid input.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an existing error inside ErrInvalidInput.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the wrapped error.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.InvalidInputInfo
methods.description: Returns the entity, field, and value related to the invalid input.

methods.name: NewErrLimitExceeded
methods.description: Creates a new ErrLimitExceeded instance.

methods.name: ErrLimitExceeded.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for limit exceeded.

methods.name: NewErrConflict
methods.description: Creates a new ErrConflict instance.

methods.name: ErrConflict.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for conflict.

methods.name: ErrConflict.Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the internal error.

methods.name: ErrConflict.IsErrConflict
methods.description: Type assertion method for ErrConflict.

methods.name: NewErrNotFound
methods.description: Creates a new ErrNotFound instance.

methods.name: ErrNotFound.Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an existing error inside ErrNotFound.

methods.name: ErrNotFound.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for not found.

methods.name: ErrNotFound.IsErrNotFound
methods.description: Type assertion method for ErrNotFound.

methods.name: NewErrOutOfBounds
methods.description: Creates a new ErrOutOfBounds instance.

methods.name: ErrOutOfBounds.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for out of bounds.

methods.name: NewErrNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates a new ErrNotImplemented instance.

methods.name: ErrNotImplemented.Error
methods.description: Returns the detail message for not implemented error.

methods.name: NewErrUniqueConstraint
methods.description: Creates a new ErrUniqueConstraint with specified columns.

methods.name: ErrUniqueConstraint.Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted message indicating the columns involved in a uniqueness constraint violation.

methods.name: IsErrNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type ErrNotFound.
